pageDescription: Turn long URLs into tidy, shareable {appName} links. Track clicks, set expiry, and revoke them whenever you like.
shortenDescription: Paste a long link, pick an optional custom code and expiry, and you're done.
passwordHelper: Visitors must enter this on a gate page before the link forwards.
useUserCodeHelp: Puts your tag in the link (/s/tag/name), so your names never clash with anyone else's. Uncheck to claim a name at the root instead.
useUserCodeLocked: Your links are namespaced under your tag. Only admins can create links at the root of the shortener.

issue.invalid-code: That custom code isn't usable - try letters and digits.
issue.code-taken: That short code is already taken
issue.code-too-long: That code is too long once your tag is added - try a shorter one.
issue.root-not-allowed: Only admins can create links at the root of the shortener.
issue.no-tag: Your account has no tag yet - set one in your profile first.

emptyDescription: Shorten your first URL above - it'll show up here with live click tracking.
emptyTip: Tip: add a custom code for memorable links
